production.direction_en: The manor shudders. Fadyme holds a stone arch above a trapped child; the recovered ledger lies open beside a handless-watch drawing.
production.music_direction_en: pre: bgm_tension (the manor shudders) | post: bgm_clockless — first hint (pizzicato only) under 'C.V.'

commands.speaker: mirel_quill
commands.text: Seven notches. The same seal. And these initials: C.V.

commands.speaker: mahmut
commands.text: The handless watch was in the portrait.

commands.speaker: fadyme
commands.text: The name is not in the ledger. We should keep moving.

commands.speaker: fadyme_thought
commands.text: The letters have found us again. I know whose hand wrote them.
